execution.os: Windows 11 local worktree; Node standard child_process.fork and IPC

evidence.sourceProvenance: Candidate package/dependencies and bounded body-stream/dom content-type helper copied from docs/changes/41/experiments/b2-vanilla/actor. Candidate implements actual parent fork/IPC/deadline path; child owns bounded fetch and Readability extraction; only parent writes outcomes.
earlierControlIterations: The initial synthetic hang used an unresolved Promise only; Node exited code 0 because no referenced event-loop handle remained. Corrected the controlled hang to keep a timer handle active until the parent kills it.

The next harness run reached all three rows but its success assertion exposed a parent/child result-field mapping gap (worker fetchStatus was not surfaced as publisherFetchStatus). Corrected the mapping before subsequent I1 runs.

outcome: All three controlled cases passed in the final run. The hanging child was killed and reaped within the deadline bounds; parent wrote one outcome per row and continued through success and child error. No HTTP promise was used for the hanging child and parent did not await it.
limitations: Local Node v20.19.0 process behavior only. Does not establish hosted Apify packaging/runtime behavior, resource use under hosted load, or the 100-row readable-text target.
nextStep: I2 is conditionally eligible under the approved TID after independent validation of I1 evidence; no I2 call/build/run occurred in this record.
